name: coordinator-transparent-routing
body: Routing is transparent. `apg node` / `apg edge` auto-detect a live session by a Unix socket at `<apg_root>/.trans/session.sock` — with a deterministic `/tmp/apg-session-<hash>.sock` fallback when the platform socket-path length limit (`SUN_LEN`, e.g. a macOS deep worktree path) is exceeded — and forward the mutation to it; when no session is running they take the direct path, which is itself serialized by the extended file-level flock over the whole durable sequence (evaluate-fix-ladder option a). The fallback path is deterministic (keyed by the canonical layout root), so the server and every client resolve the same socket with no shared state, and it is cleaned up when the session ends or the next start reclaims a stale one. The `apg_node` / `apg_edge` tool surface, the CLI arguments, and every agent prompt are unchanged — the agents cannot tell whether a coordinator is running. Acceptance: the same command works identically with and without a live session, and no tool/agent surface changes.
